name: ms-reto-aws-users-serverless
description: Four AWS Lambda user endpoints deployed through Serverless Framework

scripts.build:java: cd java && /opt/homebrew/bin/mise exec java@21 -- ./mvnw clean package
scripts.test: npm run test:java && npm run test:node
scripts.package: npm run build:java && npm run install:node --silent && serverless package
scripts.deploy: npm run build:java && npm run install:node --silent && serverless deploy
